There should be enough capacity to prevent recycle containers from overflowing.
The Rule of Thumb for the minimum recycling capacity is 1 cubic yard per week for every
10 units within the property.*

10 units 1 cu. yd. recycling per week
two 96-gal.
carts picked up
1 x week
40 units 4 cu. yd. recycling per week
one 4 cu. yd.
container picked up
1 x per week
OR
four 96-gal.
carts picked up
2 x week

Checklist
For A
Successful
Recycling
Program

 Recycling for all designated recyclables made available
 Recycling is as convenient & accessible as garbage
disposal
 Each unit is provided with an indoor recycle storage
container
 Educational signs placed at each recycling collection
area
 Garbage & recycle collection containers are properly
labeled
 New residents received recycling information on
move-in
 Residents receive recycling info at least once per year
 Adequate recycling container capacity and service (no
overflow or spillage)
